<h1 id="airbyte-configuration-api">Airbyte Configuration API v1.0.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Airbyte Configuration API
[https://airbyte.io](https://airbyte.io).

The Configuration API is an internal Airbyte API that is designed for communications between different Airbyte components.
* It's main purpose is to enable the Airbyte Engineering team to configure the internal state of [Airbyte Cloud](https://airbyte.com/airbyte-cloud)
* It is also sometimes used by OSS users to configure their own Self-Hosted Airbyte deployment (internal state, etc)

WARNING
* Airbyte does NOT have active commitments to support this API long-term.
* OSS users can utilize the Configuration API, but at their own risk.
* This API is utilized internally by the Airbyte Engineering team and may be modified in the future if the need arises.
* Modifications by the Airbyte Engineering team could create breaking changes and OSS users would need to update their code to catch up to any backwards incompatible changes in the API.

This API is a collection of HTTP RPC-style methods. While it is not a REST API, those familiar with REST should find the conventions of this API recognizable.

Here are some conventions that this API follows:
* All endpoints are http POST methods.
* All endpoints accept data via `application/json` request bodies. The API does not accept any data via query params.
* The naming convention for endpoints is: localhost:8000/{VERSION}/{METHOD_FAMILY}/{METHOD_NAME} e.g. `localhost:8000/v1/connections/create`.
* For all `update` methods, the whole object must be passed in, even the fields that did not change.

Authentication (OSS):
* When authenticating to the Configuration API, you must use Basic Authentication by setting the Authentication Header to Basic and base64 encoding the username and password (which are `airbyte` and `password` by default - so base64 encoding `airbyte:password` results in `YWlyYnl0ZTpwYXNzd29yZA==`). So the full header reads `'Authorization': "Basic YWlyYnl0ZTpwYXNzd29yZA=="`

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://cloud.airbyte.com/api">https://cloud.airbyte.com/api</a> - Airbyte Cloud

* <a href="http://localhost:8000/api">http://localhost:8000/api</a> - Local Development

Email: <a href="mailto:contact@airbyte.io">contact@airbyte.io</a> 
License: <a href="https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT">MIT</a>

<a href="https://airbyte.io">Find out more about Airbyte</a>

# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

<h1 id="airbyte-configuration-api-workspace">workspace</h1>

Workspace related resources.

## Creates a workspace

<a id="opIdcreateWorkspace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/workspaces/create \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "anonymousDataCollection": true,
    "name": "string",
    "news": true,
    "securityUpdates": true,
    "notifications": [
      {
        "notificationType": "slack",
        "sendOnSuccess": false,
        "sendOnFailure": true,
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      }
    ],
    "notificationSettings": {
      "sendOnSuccess": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnFailure": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnSyncDisabled": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnSyncDisabledWarning": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnConnectionUpdate": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnConnectionUpdateActionRequired": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnBreakingChangeWarning": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnBreakingChangeSyncsDisabled": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      },
      "sendOnConnectionSyncQueued": {
        "notificationType": [
          "slack"
        ],
        "slackConfiguration": {
          "webhook": "string"
        },
        "customerioConfiguration": {}
      }
    },
    "displaySetupWizard": true,
    "dataplaneGroupId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "webhookConfigs": [
      {
        "name": "string",
        "authToken": "string",
        "validationUrl": "string",
        "customDbtHost": "string"
      }
    ],
    "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  }'
```

## Deletes a workspace

<a id="opIddeleteWorkspace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/workspaces/delete \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "workspaceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "includeTombstone": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/workspaces/delete`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "workspaceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "includeTombstone": true
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-a-workspace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

<h3 id="create-a-connection-between-a-source-and-a-destination-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ConnectionCreate](#schemaconnectioncreate)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional name of the connection|
|» namespaceDefinition|body|[NamespaceDefinitionType](#schemanamespacedefinitiontype)|false|Method used for computing final namespace in destination|
|» namespaceFormat|body|string|false|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'customformat'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination.|
|» sourceId|body|[SourceId](#schemasourceid)|true|none|
|» destinationId|body|[DestinationId](#schemadestinationid)|true|none|
|» operationIds|body|[[OperationId](#schemaoperationid)]|false|none|
|» syncCatalog|body|[AirbyteCatalog](#schemaairbytecatalog)|false|describes the available schema (catalog).|
|» schedule|body|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|» scheduleType|body|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|» scheduleData|body|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|true|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|» resourceRequirements|body|[ResourceRequirements](#schemaresourcerequirements)|false|optional resource requirements to run workers (blank for unbounded allocations)|
|» sourceCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» destinationCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» dataplaneGroupId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChanges|body|boolean|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChangesByEmail|body|boolean|false|none|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|body|[NonBreakingChangesPreference](#schemanonbreakingchangespreference)|false|none|
|» backfillPreference|body|[SchemaChangeBackfillPreference](#schemaschemachangebackfillpreference)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|
|» onDemandEnabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this connection will use on-demand capacity if committed capacity is exhausted|
|» enableIndexing|body|boolean|false|Enables Fusion indexing for this connection. Defaults to false. Setting this to true is validated the same way as POST /v1/connections/{connectionId}/enablement: an ineligible organization is rejected before anything is created. If eligible, the connection is created and indexing is then synced to Sonar/Agents; if that sync fails, the create still succeeds and the error is returned, but the connection is left with indexing disabled.|

`POST /v1/connections/update`

Apply a patch-style update to a connection. Only fields present on the update request body will be updated.
Note that if a catalog is present in the request body, the connection's entire catalog will be replaced
with the catalog from the request. This means that to modify a single stream, the entire new catalog
containing the updated stream needs to be sent.

|» syncCatalog|body|[AirbyteCatalog](#schemaairbytecatalog)|false|describes the available schema (catalog).|
|» schedule|body|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|» scheduleType|body|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|» scheduleData|body|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|false|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|» resourceRequirements|body|[ResourceRequirements](#schemaresourcerequirements)|false|optional resource requirements to run workers (blank for unbounded allocations)|
|» sourceCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» destinationCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» dataplaneGroupId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChanges|body|boolean|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChangesByEmail|body|boolean|false|none|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|body|[NonBreakingChangesPreference](#schemanonbreakingchangespreference)|false|none|
|» backfillPreference|body|[SchemaChangeBackfillPreference](#schemaschemachangebackfillpreference)|false|none|
|» breakingChange|body|boolean|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|
|» onDemandEnabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this connection will use on-demand capacity if committed capacity is exhausted|
|» enableIndexing|body|boolean|false|Enables or disables Fusion indexing for this connection. Omitted or null leaves the current value unchanged. A value that differs from the current one is validated and applied the same way as PUT /v1/connections/{connectionId}/enablement (organization eligibility, synced to Sonar/Agents); the rest of the update is applied first and stays applied even if this validation or sync then fails, in which case this field's error is returned instead of the update's.|

<h3 id="search-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ConnectionSearch](#schemaconnectionsearch)|true|none|
|» connectionId|body|[ConnectionId](#schemaconnectionid)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» namespaceDefinition|body|[NamespaceDefinitionType](#schemanamespacedefinitiontype)|false|Method used for computing final namespace in destination|
|» namespaceFormat|body|string|false|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'customformat'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination.|
|» sourceId|body|[SourceId](#schemasourceid)|false|none|
|» destinationId|body|[DestinationId](#schemadestinationid)|false|none|
|» schedule|body|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|» scheduleType|body|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|» scheduleData|body|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|false|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|» source|body|[SourceSearch](#schemasourcesearch)|false|none|
|» destination|body|[DestinationSearch](#schemadestinationsearch)|false|none|

|» scheduleType|manual|
|» scheduleType|basic|

|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|
|» status|deprecated|

## Sets connection to inactive if it has met any of the auto-disable conditions (i.e. it hits the max number of consecutive job failures or if it hits the max number of days with only failed jobs). Additionally, notifications will be sent if a connection is disabled or warned if it has reached halfway to disable limits. This endpoint is only able to inactivate connections with more than one non-cancelled job.

<a id="opIdautoDisableConnection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/connections/auto_disable \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "connectionId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/connections/auto_disable`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connectionId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

```bash
  }'
```

## Sets instancewide variables to be used for the oauth flow when creating this destination. When set, these variables will be injected into a connector's configuration before any interaction with the connector image itself. This enables running oauth flows with consistent variables e.g: the company's Google Ads developer_token, client_id, and client_secret without the user having to know about these variables.

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/destination_oauths/oauth_params/create \
  -X POST \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{

    "params": {}
```

<h3 id="create-a-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[WebBackendConnectionCreate](#schemawebbackendconnectioncreate)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional name of the connection|
|» namespaceDefinition|body|[NamespaceDefinitionType](#schemanamespacedefinitiontype)|false|Method used for computing final namespace in destination|
|» namespaceFormat|body|string|false|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'customformat'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination.|
|» sourceId|body|[SourceId](#schemasourceid)|true|none|
|» destinationId|body|[DestinationId](#schemadestinationid)|true|none|
|» operationIds|body|[[OperationId](#schemaoperationid)]|false|none|
|» syncCatalog|body|[AirbyteCatalog](#schemaairbytecatalog)|false|describes the available schema (catalog).|
|» schedule|body|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|» scheduleType|body|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|» scheduleData|body|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|true|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|» resourceRequirements|body|[ResourceRequirements](#schemaresourcerequirements)|false|optional resource requirements to run workers (blank for unbounded allocations)|
|» operations|body|[[OperationCreate](#schemaoperationcreate)]|false|none|
|» sourceCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» destinationCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» dataplaneGroupId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChanges|body|boolean|false|none|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|body|[NonBreakingChangesPreference](#schemanonbreakingchangespreference)|false|none|
|» backfillPreference|body|[SchemaChangeBackfillPreference](#schemaschemachangebackfillpreference)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|
|» onDemandEnabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this connection will use on-demand capacity if committed capacity is exhausted|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» namespaceDefinition|source|
|» namespaceDefinition|destination|
|» namespaceDefinition|customformat|
|» scheduleType|manual|
|» scheduleType|basic|
|» scheduleType|cron|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|
|» status|deprecated|
|» status|locked|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|ignore|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|disable|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|propagate_columns|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|propagate_fully|
|» backfillPreference|enabled|
|» backfillPreference|disabled|

`POST /v1/web_backend/connections/update`

Apply a patch-style update to a connection. Only fields present on the update request body will be updated.
Any operations that lack an ID will be created. Then, the newly created operationId will be applied to the
connection along with the rest of the operationIds in the request body.
Apply a patch-style update to a connection. Only fields present on the update request body will be updated.
Note that if a catalog is present in the request body, the connection's entire catalog will be replaced
with the catalog from the request. This means that to modify a single stream, the entire new catalog
containing the updated stream needs to be sent.

<h3 id="update-a-connection-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[WebBackendConnectionUpdate](#schemawebbackendconnectionupdate)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Name that will be set to the connection|
|» connectionId|body|[ConnectionId](#schemaconnectionid)|true|none|
|» namespaceDefinition|body|[NamespaceDefinitionType](#schemanamespacedefinitiontype)|false|Method used for computing final namespace in destination|
|» namespaceFormat|body|string|false|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'customformat'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination.|
|» syncCatalog|body|[AirbyteCatalog](#schemaairbytecatalog)|false|describes the available schema (catalog).|
|» schedule|body|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|» scheduleType|body|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|» scheduleData|body|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|false|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|» resourceRequirements|body|[ResourceRequirements](#schemaresourcerequirements)|false|optional resource requirements to run workers (blank for unbounded allocations)|
|» skipReset|body|boolean|false|none|
|» operations|body|[[WebBackendOperationCreateOrUpdate](#schemawebbackendoperationcreateorupdate)]|false|none|
|» sourceCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» destinationCatalogId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» dataplaneGroupId|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChanges|body|boolean|false|none|
|» notifySchemaChangesByEmail|body|boolean|false|none|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|body|[NonBreakingChangesPreference](#schemanonbreakingchangespreference)|false|none|
|» backfillPreference|body|[SchemaChangeBackfillPreference](#schemaschemachangebackfillpreference)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|
|» onDemandEnabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this connection will use on-demand capacity if committed capacity is exhausted|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|» namespaceDefinition|destination|
|» namespaceDefinition|customformat|
|» scheduleType|manual|
|» scheduleType|basic|
|» scheduleType|cron|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|
|» status|deprecated|
|» status|locked|
|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|ignore|

|» nonBreakingChangesPreference|propagate_fully|
|» backfillPreference|enabled|

```bash
  }'
```

```json
{
  "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "recipientEmail": "user@example.com",
  "syncCreditThreshold": 0,
  "invoiceAmountThreshold": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-the-billing-notification-settings-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BillingNotificationSettingsUpdateRequestBody](#schemabillingnotificationsettingsupdaterequestbody)|true|none|
|» organizationId|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» recipientEmail|body|string(email) \| null|false|Address that receives billing alerts. Null or empty means the payment provider email is used. The update replaces every field, so omit it or send null to clear a stored address.|
|» syncCreditThreshold|body|number|true|Estimated credits consumed by a single sync. 0 disables the alert.|
|» invoiceAmountThreshold|body|number|true|Billing period amount in USD. 0 disables the alert.|

```json
{
  "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "configured": true,
  "recipientEmail": "user@example.com",
  "syncCreditThreshold": 0,
  "invoiceAmountThreshold": 0
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful operation|[BillingNotificationSettingsRead](#schemabillingnotificationsettingsread)|
|400|Bad Request|A required field is missing, a threshold is below zero, or the recipient email is malformed or longer than 256 characters|None|

This operation does not require authentication

## List Jobs by sync type

<a id="opIdlistJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /public/v1/jobs`

<h3 id="list-jobs-by-sync-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|connectionId|query|string(UUID)|false|Filter the Jobs by connectionId.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Set the limit on the number of Jobs returned. The default is 20 Jobs.|
|offset|query|integer(int32)|false|Set the offset to start at when returning Jobs. The default is 0.|
|jobType|query|[JobTypeEnum](#schemajobtypeenum)|false|Filter the Jobs by jobType.|
|workspaceIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The UUIDs of the workspaces you wish to list jobs for. Empty list will retrieve all allowed workspaces.|
|status|query|[JobStatusEnum](#schemajobstatusenum)|false|The Job status you want to filter by|
|createdAtStart|query|string(date-time)|false|The start date to filter by|
|createdAtEnd|query|string(date-time)|false|The end date to filter by|
|updatedAtStart|query|string(date-time)|false|The start date to filter by|
|updatedAtEnd|query|string(date-time)|false|The end date to filter by|
|orderBy|query|string|false|The field and method to use for ordering|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|jobType|sync|
|jobType|reset|
|jobType|refresh|
|jobType|clear|
|status|pending|
|status|queued|
|status|running|
|status|incomplete|
|status|failed|
|status|succeeded|
|status|cancelled|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next": "https://api.airbyte.com/v1/jobs?limit=5&offset=10",
  "previous": "https://api.airbyte.com/v1/jobs?limit=5&offset=0",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "18dccc91-0ab1-4f72-9ed7-0b8fc27c5826",
      "status": "running",
      "jobType": "sync"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-jobs-by-sync-type-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|List all the Jobs by connectionId.|[JobsResponse](#schemajobsresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|Not allowed|None|

This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

`GET /v1/sources/{sourceId}/enablement`

Internal Config API only. POST initializes all-false flags with null backfill start timestamp or retries identical state, otherwise returns 409. PUT requires the last-read expectedState and atomically compares all flags and nullable backfill start timestamp, returning 409 on stale state. Omitted or null backfill start timestamp clears the configured value. DELETE clears all flags and backfill start timestamp without deleting the actor. Search indexing requires enable_agent_access. Sources cannot configure enable_backfill or backfill start timestamp. Enabling flags or changing backfill start timestamp while enable_backfill is enabled requires an Airbyte-managed region; disabling flags remains possible after region moves.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|sourceId|path|string(uuid)|true|none|

```json
  "actorId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

  "enable_agent_access": true,
  "enable_indexing": true
}
```

`POST /v1/connections/resolve_enablement_for_sync`

<h1 id="airbyte-configuration-api-fusionconnectionbackfill">fusion_connection_backfill</h1>

## Request a Fusion backfill for a connection (Cloud only)

<a id="opIdrequestFusionConnectionBackfill"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/connections/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/backfill \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "streams": [
      "string"
    ],
    "start_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/connections/{connectionId}/backfill`

Forwards to Agents, which queues one backfill run per named stream, or one all-streams run when streams is omitted, and reports each stream's outcome. A stream whose current run is still queued or running keeps it and comes back as running, so retrying is safe. Requires the connection to be enabled for Fusion indexing.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "streams": [
    "string"
  ],
  "start_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="request-a-fusion-backfill-for-a-connection-cloud-only-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|connectionId|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[FusionConnectionBackfillRequest](#schemafusionconnectionbackfillrequest)|true|none|
|» streams|body|[string]|false|Distinct stream names to backfill, one run each. Omitted means every stream the connection's catalog selects.|
|» start_time|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Backfill only rows whose cursor field (a top-level timestamp or date) is at or after this time; streams without such a cursor are backfilled in full. Omitted or null, the whole history. Regular syncs index all data regardless.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "streams": [
    {
      "stream_name": "string",
      "outcome": "requested",
      "run_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "backfill": {
        "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "stream_name": "string",
        "connection_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "source_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "destination_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "workspace_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "requested_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "started_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "completed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "failed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "cancel_requested_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "cancelled_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "expected_total_rows": 0,
        "error": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="request-a-fusion-backfill-for-a-connection-cloud-only-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Per-stream backfill outcomes|[FusionConnectionBackfillResponse](#schemafusionconnectionbackfillresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication required|None|
|403|Forbidden|Insufficient workspace permission|None|
|404|Not Found|Connection not found|None|
|409|Conflict|Connection is not enabled for Fusion backfill, or the request conflicts with the current resource state|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid backfill request|None|
|502|Bad Gateway|Invalid upstream response|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|Upstream unavailable|None|
|504|Gateway Timeout|Upstream timed out|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="airbyte-configuration-api-sourceexecution">source_execution</h1>

## Execute a read-only source action

<a id="opIdexecuteSource"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/sources/string/execute \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "entity": "string",
    "action": "string",
    "params": {},
    "select_fields": [
      "string"
    ],
    "exclude_fields": [
      "string"
    ],
    "skip_truncation": true,
    "intent": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/sources/{sourceId}/execute`

Executes a supported JSON-only direct read for an explicitly enabled Cloud source. Available entities, actions and parameters depend on the source connector. Describe, writes, downloads, streaming and Context Store operations are not supported. Controlled Cloud-only availability; this operation is unavailable (503) until the execution backend is configured. This route is not exposed in non-Cloud deployments. Requires reader access to the source workspace. An organization administrator must enable the Context layer for the organization and workspace, and the source must be enabled for agent access. Semantic-search indexing is not required. Requests are limited to 64 KiB and responses to 1 MiB. Production activation is coordinated separately.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "entity": "string",
  "action": "string",
  "params": {},
  "select_fields": [
    "string"
  ],
  "exclude_fields": [
    "string"
  ],
  "skip_truncation": true,
  "intent": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="execute-a-read-only-source-action-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sourceId|path|string(UUID)|true|none|
|body|body|[SourceExecuteRequest](#schemasourceexecuterequest)|true|none|
|» entity|body|string|true|none|
|» action|body|string|true|Direct read action, such as get, list or api_search, when supported by the connector.|
|» params|body|[SourceExecuteParams](#schemasourceexecuteparams)|false|Connector-specific JSON parameters, preserving nested nulls. Defaults to an empty object when omitted.|
|» select_fields|body|[string]|false|Dot-path field allowlist. Takes precedence over exclude_fields.|
|» exclude_fields|body|[string]|false|Dot-path fields to omit when select_fields is not provided.|
|» skip_truncation|body|boolean|false|Disable truncation of long text fields in list and api_search responses.|
|» intent|body|string \| null|false|Caller-provided purpose recorded with execution auditing.|

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/list \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "configTypes": [
      "check_connection_source"
    ],
    "configId": "string",
    "includingJobId": 0,
    "pagination": {
      "pageSize": 0,
      "rowOffset": 0
    },
    "statuses": [
      "pending"
    ],
    "createdAtStart": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "createdAtEnd": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "updatedAtStart": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "updatedAtEnd": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "orderByField": "createdAt",
    "orderByMethod": "ASC"
  }'
```

```json
{
  "configTypes": [
    "check_connection_source"
  ],

}
```

<h3 id="returns-recent-jobs-for-a-connection-jobs-are-returned-in-descending-order-by-createdat-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[JobListRequestBody](#schemajoblistrequestbody)|true|none|
|» configTypes|body|[[JobConfigType](#schemajobconfigtype)]|true|none|
|» configId|body|string|false|none|
|» includingJobId|body|[JobId](#schemajobid)|false|If the job with this ID exists for the specified connection, returns the number of pages of jobs necessary to include this job. Returns an empty list if this job is specified and cannot be found in this connection.|

## Start a connector rollout by ID. This will update the state of the rollout from INITIALIZED to WORKFLOW_STARTED, and add the Temporal run ID of the workflow to the rollout entry.

<a id="opIdstartConnectorRollout"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/connector_rollout/start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "workflow_run_id": "string",
```

<a id="opIdrunSpecCommand"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/commands/run/spec \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "id": "string",
    "workspace_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "docker_image": "string",
    "docker_image_tag": "string",
    "actor_definition_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "signal_input": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/commands/run/spec`

Expected input is an id and either a docker_image and docker_image_tag to run spec for a custom connector or an actor_definition_id and docker_image_tag to run spec for a registered actor definition.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "workspace_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "docker_image": "string",
  "docker_image_tag": "string",
  "actor_definition_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "signal_input": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="run-a-spec-command-for-a-connector-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» id|body|string|true|a command id which acts as an idempotency key.|
|» workspace_id|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» docker_image|body|string|false|the docker image (without tag) for a custom connector|
|» docker_image_tag|body|string|true|the docker image tag|
|» actor_definition_id|body|string(uuid)|false|the actor definition id for a registered connector|
|» signal_input|body|string|false|internal usage|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="run-a-spec-command-for-a-connector-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|

<h3 id="run-a-spec-command-for-a-connector-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="airbyte-configuration-api-auditlogs">audit_logs</h1>

## List audit log entries for an organization

<a id="opIdlistAuditLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/audit_logs/list \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "startTime": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
    "endTime": "2026-08-14T00:00:00Z",
    "workspaceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "actorId": "string",
    "operation": "string",
    "success": true,
    "searchText": "string",
    "pageSize": 50,
    "pageToken": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/audit_logs/list`

Returns audit log entries for the caller's organization, newest first. Requires the organization admin role and the feature-audit-logging entitlement. The organizationId in the request body must match the organization resolved from the authenticated request context; only that organization's entries are ever returned.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "startTime": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
  "endTime": "2026-08-14T00:00:00Z",
  "workspaceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "actorId": "string",
  "operation": "string",
  "success": true,
  "searchText": "string",
  "pageSize": 50,
  "pageToken": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="list-audit-log-entries-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AuditLogListRequestBody](#schemaauditloglistrequestbody)|true|none|
|» organizationId|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» startTime|body|string(date-time)|false|Inclusive start of the time range. Defaults to 30 days before endTime.|
|» endTime|body|string(date-time)|false|Inclusive end of the time range. Defaults to now. The range between startTime and endTime must not exceed 90 days.|
|» workspaceId|body|string(uuid)|false|Convenience filter on the workspace the audited action belongs to. Not an authorization boundary.|
|» actorId|body|string|false|Case-insensitive substring match over the actor id and the actor email of an entry.|
|» operation|body|string|false|Case-insensitive substring match over the operation of an entry.|
|» success|body|boolean|false|none|
|» searchText|body|string|false|Case-insensitive substring match over the operation, actor, and error message of an entry.|
|» pageSize|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» pageToken|body|string|false|Opaque resume token from a previous response's nextPageToken. Must be combined with otherwise-identical query parameters.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "auditLogs": [
    {
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "timestamp": 0,
      "actor": {
        "actorId": "string",
        "email": "string",
        "ipAddress": "string",
        "userAgent": "string"
      },
      "operation": "string",
      "request": {},
      "response": {},
      "success": true,
      "errorMessage": "string",
      "organizationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "workspaceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    }
  ],

}
```

## Create a source

<a id="opIdpublicCreateSource"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/sources \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "configuration": {
      "airbyte_source_name": "google-ads",
      "conversion_window_days": 14,
      "customer_id": "1234567890",
      "start_date": "2023-01-01",
      "end_date": "2024-01-01"
    },
    "name": "My Source",
    "workspaceId": "744cc0ed-7f05-4949-9e60-2a814f90c035"
  }'
```

`POST /public/v1/sources`

Creates a source given a name, workspace id, and a json blob containing the configuration for the source.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "configuration": {
    "airbyte_source_name": "google-ads",
    "conversion_window_days": 14,
    "customer_id": "1234567890",
    "start_date": "2023-01-01",
    "end_date": "2024-01-01"
  },
  "name": "My Source",
  "workspaceId": "744cc0ed-7f05-4949-9e60-2a814f90c035"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-source-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SourceCreateRequest](#schemasourcecreaterequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the source e.g. dev-mysql-instance.|
|» definitionId|body|string(uuid)|false|The UUID of the connector definition. One of configuration.sourceType or definitionId must be provided.|
|» workspaceId|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» configuration|body|[SourceConfiguration](#schemasourceconfiguration)|true|The values required to configure the source. The schema for this must match the schema return by source_definition_specifications/get for the source.|
|» secretId|body|string|false|Optional secretID obtained through the  OAuth redirect flow.|
|» resourceAllocation|body|[ScopedResourceRequirements](#schemascopedresourcerequirements)|false|actor or actor definition specific resource requirements. if default is set, these are the requirements that should be set for ALL jobs run for this actor definition. it is overriden by the job type specific configurations. if not set, the platform will use defaults. these values will be overriden by configuration at the connection level.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "sourceId": "0c31738c-0b2d-4887-b506-e2cd1c39cc35"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-source-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful operation|[SourceResponse](#schemasourceresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid data|None|
|403|Forbidden|Not allowed|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Initiate OAuth for a source

<a id="opIdinitiateOAuth"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/sources/initiateOAuth \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "redirectUrl": "https://cloud.airbyte.io/v1/api/oauth/callback",
    "workspaceId": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
    "destinationId": "3d93b16c-ff5f-421c-8908-5a3c82088f14"
  }'
```

`POST /public/v1/sources/initiateOAuth`

Given a source ID, workspace ID, and redirect URL, initiates OAuth for the source.

This returns a fully formed URL for performing user authentication against the relevant source identity provider (IdP). Once authentication has been completed, the IdP will redirect to an Airbyte endpoint which will save the access and refresh tokens off as a secret and return the secret ID to the redirect URL specified in the `secret_id` query string parameter.

That secret ID can be used to create a source with credentials in place of actual tokens. By default (`clientType=api` or omitted), callback behavior is unchanged. If `clientType=webapp`, callback redirects with provider callback query params and does not create a secret during callback.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "redirectUrl": "https://cloud.airbyte.io/v1/api/oauth/callback",
  "workspaceId": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
  "destinationId": "3d93b16c-ff5f-421c-8908-5a3c82088f14"
}
```

<h3 id="initiate-oauth-for-a-source-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[InitiateOauthRequest](#schemainitiateoauthrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the source to authenticate to. Deprecated - use sourceType instead.|
|» sourceType|body|string|false|The name of the source to authenticate to|
|» redirectUrl|body|string|true|Redirect target after OAuth callback. In `api` mode, callback includes `secret_id`, `state`, `workspace_id`, and `definition_id`. In `webapp` mode, callback forwards all provider callback query params.|
|» clientType|body|string|false|OAuth callback mode. `api` is default when omitted. `webapp` forwards provider callback query params and does not create a secret during callback.|
|» workspaceId|body|string(uuid)|true|The workspace to create the secret and eventually the full source.|
|» oAuthInputConfiguration|body|[OAuthInputConfiguration](#schemaoauthinputconfiguration)|false|Input configuration for OAuth required by some sources.|
|» requestedScopes|body|[string]|false|Optional OAuth scopes to request, overriding the connector's default scopes. Only supported for connectors that define scopes as an array.|
|» requestedOptionalScopes|body|[string]|false|Optional OAuth optional_scopes to request, overriding the connector's default optional_scopes. Only applied when requestedScopes is also provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» clientType|api|
|» clientType|webapp|

<h3 id="initiate-oauth-for-a-source-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Response from the initiate OAuth call should be an object with a single property which will be the `redirect_url`. If a user is redirected to this URL, they'll be prompted by the identity provider to authenticate.|None|
|400|Bad Request|A field in the body has not been set appropriately.|None|
|403|Forbidden|API key is invalid.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/connections/string \
```

```bash
  }'
```

`PATCH /public/v1/connections/{connectionId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sourceId": "95e66a59-8045-4307-9678-63bc3c9b8c93",
  "destinationId": "e478de0d-a3a0-475c-b019-25f7dd29e281",
  "name": "Postgres-to-Bigquery"
}
```

<h3 id="update-connection-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|connectionId|path|string(UUID)|true|none|
|body|body|[ConnectionPatchRequest](#schemaconnectionpatchrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional name of the connection|
|» configurations|body|[StreamConfigurations](#schemastreamconfigurations)|false|A list of configured stream options for a connection.|
|» schedule|body|[AirbyteApiConnectionSchedule](#schemaairbyteapiconnectionschedule)|false|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|» dataResidency|body|string|false|**Deprecated.**|
|» namespaceDefinition|body|[NamespaceDefinitionEnumNoDefault](#schemanamespacedefinitionenumnodefault)|false|Define the location where the data will be stored in the destination|
|» namespaceFormat|body|string|false|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'custom_format'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination (ex. “airbyte_” causes “projects” => “airbyte_projects”).|
|» nonBreakingSchemaUpdatesBehavior|body|[NonBreakingSchemaUpdatesBehaviorEnumNoDefault](#schemanonbreakingschemaupdatesbehaviorenumnodefault)|false|Set how Airbyte handles syncs when it detects a non-breaking schema change in the source|
|» status|body|[ConnectionStatusEnum](#schemaconnectionstatusenum)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|

|» namespaceDefinition|destination|
|» namespaceDefinition|custom_format|

|» nonBreakingSchemaUpdatesBehavior|disable_connection|
|» nonBreakingSchemaUpdatesBehavior|propagate_columns|
|» nonBreakingSchemaUpdatesBehavior|propagate_fully|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|
|» status|deprecated|
|» status|locked|

```json
  "destinationId": "744cc0ed-7f05-4949-9e60-2a814f90c035"
}
```

## Create OAuth override credentials for a workspace and source type.

<a id="opIdcreateOrUpdateWorkspaceOAuthCredentials"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/workspaces/string/oauthCredentials \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "actorType": "source",
    "name": "string",
    "configuration": {
      "credentials": {
        "client_id": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
        "client_secret": "shhhhhh"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /public/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/oauthCredentials`

Create/update a set of OAuth credentials to override the Airbyte-provided OAuth credentials used for source/destination OAuth.
In order to determine what the credential configuration needs to be, please see the connector specification of the relevant source/destination.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "actorType": "source",
  "name": "string",
  "configuration": {
    "credentials": {
      "client_id": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
      "client_secret": "shhhhhh"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-oauth-override-credentials-for-a-workspace-and-source-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workspaceId|path|string(UUID)|true|none|
|body|body|[WorkspaceOAuthCredentialsRequest](#schemaworkspaceoauthcredentialsrequest)|true|none|
|» actorType|body|[ActorTypeEnum](#schemaactortypeenum)|true|Whether you're setting this override for a source or destination|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the source i.e. google-ads|
|» configuration|body|[OAuthCredentialsConfiguration](#schemaoauthcredentialsconfiguration)|true|The configuration for this source/destination based on the OAuth section of the relevant specification.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» actorType|source|
|» actorType|destination|

<h3 id="create-oauth-override-credentials-for-a-workspace-and-source-type-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OAuth credential override was successful.|None|
|400|Bad Request|A field in the body has not been set appropriately.|None|
|403|Forbidden|API key is invalid.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Delete OAuth override credentials for a workspace and source/destination type.

<a id="opIddeleteWorkspaceOAuthCredentials"></a>

```bash
  -X DELETE
```

`DELETE /public/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/oauthCredentials/{actorType}/{name}`

Delete a set of OAuth credentials that overrides the Airbyte-provided OAuth credentials used for source/destination OAuth.

> 🚧Warning > > Deleting an override that is actively used by existing sources or destinations will cause those connectors to fail on their next sync and require re-authentication.

|actorType|source|
|actorType|destination|

|---|---|---|---|

## Create OAuth override credentials for an organization and source type.

<a id="opIdcreateOrUpdateOrganizationOAuthCredentials"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1/organizations/string/oauthCredentials \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "actorType": "source",
    "name": "string",
    "configuration": {
      "credentials": {
        "client_id": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
        "client_secret": "shhhhhh"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /public/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/oauthCredentials`

Create/update a set of OAuth credentials to override the Airbyte-provided OAuth credentials used for source/destination OAuth.
In order to determine what the credential configuration needs to be, please see the connector specification of the relevant source/destination.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "actorType": "source",
  "name": "string",
  "configuration": {
    "credentials": {
      "client_id": "871d9b60-11d1-44cb-8c92-c246d53bf87e",
      "client_secret": "shhhhhh"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-oauth-override-credentials-for-an-organization-and-source-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(UUID)|true|none|
|body|body|[OrganizationOAuthCredentialsRequest](#schemaorganizationoauthcredentialsrequest)|true|none|
|» actorType|body|[ActorTypeEnum](#schemaactortypeenum)|true|Whether you're setting this override for a source or destination|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the source i.e. google-ads|
|» configuration|body|[OAuthCredentialsConfiguration](#schemaoauthcredentialsconfiguration)|true|The configuration for this source/destination based on the OAuth section of the relevant specification.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» actorType|source|
|» actorType|destination|

<h3 id="create-oauth-override-credentials-for-an-organization-and-source-type-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OAuth credential override was successful.|None|
|400|Bad Request|A field in the body has not been set appropriately.|None|
|403|Forbidden|API key is invalid.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

|actorType|destination|

Read UTC calendar day and month enforcement counters. Requires organization membership or access to a workspace in the organization.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

```json
  "freeCapsApplicable": true,
  "day": {
    "limit": 0,
    "used": 0,
    "windowStart": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "resetsAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "month": {
    "limit": 0,
    "used": 0,
    "windowStart": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "resetsAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

|409|Conflict|No active workspace exists for the organization|None|
|502|Bad Gateway|Invalid upstream response|None|

|catalogId|string(uuid)|false|none|none|
|catalogDiff|[CatalogDiff](#schemacatalogdiff)|false|none|Describes the difference between two Airbyte catalogs.|
|breakingChange|boolean|false|none|none|
|connectionStatus|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|false|none|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|

|Property|Value|

|connectionStatus|active|
|connectionStatus|inactive|
|connectionStatus|deprecated|
|connectionStatus|locked|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|Optional name of the connection|
|namespaceDefinition|[NamespaceDefinitionType](#schemanamespacedefinitiontype)|false|none|Method used for computing final namespace in destination|
|namespaceFormat|string|false|none|Used when namespaceDefinition is 'customformat'. If blank then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'destination'. If "${SOURCE_NAMESPACE}" then behaves like namespaceDefinition = 'source'.|
|prefix|string|false|none|Prefix that will be prepended to the name of each stream when it is written to the destination.|
|sourceId|[SourceId](#schemasourceid)|true|none|none|
|destinationId|[DestinationId](#schemadestinationid)|true|none|none|
|operationIds|[[OperationId](#schemaoperationid)]|false|none|none|
|syncCatalog|[AirbyteCatalog](#schemaairbytecatalog)|false|none|describes the available schema (catalog).|
|schedule|[ConnectionSchedule](#schemaconnectionschedule)|false|none|if null, then no schedule is set.|
|scheduleType|[ConnectionScheduleType](#schemaconnectionscheduletype)|false|none|determine how the schedule data should be interpreted|
|scheduleData|[ConnectionScheduleData](#schemaconnectionscheduledata)|false|none|schedule for when the the connection should run, per the schedule type|
|status|[ConnectionStatus](#schemaconnectionstatus)|true|none|Active means that data is flowing through the connection. Inactive means it is not. Deprecated means the connection is off and cannot be re-activated. Locked means the connection is temporarily disabled due to external factors (e.g., payment issues). The schema field describes the elements of the schema that will be synced.|
|resourceRequirements|[ResourceRequirements](#schemaresourcerequirements)|false|none|optional resource requirements to run workers (blank for unbounded allocations)|
|sourceCatalogId|string(uuid)|false|none|none|
|destinationCatalogId|string(uuid)|false|none|none|
|dataplaneGroupId|string(uuid)|false|none|none|
|notifySchemaChanges|boolean|false|none|none|
|notifySchemaChangesByEmail|boolean|false|none|none|
|nonBreakingChangesPreference|[NonBreakingChangesPreference](#schemanonbreakingchangespreference)|false|none|none|
|backfillPreference|[SchemaChangeBackfillPreference](#schemaschemachangebackfillpreference)|false|none|none|
|tags|[[Tag](#schematag)]|false|none|none|
|onDemandEnabled|boolean|false|none|When enabled, this connection will use on-demand capacity if committed capacity is exhausted|
|enableIndexing|boolean|false|none|Enables Fusion indexing for this connection. Defaults to false. Setting this to true is validated the same way as POST /v1/connections/{connectionId}/enablement: an ineligible organization is rejected before anything is created. If eligible, the connection is created and indexing is then synced to Sonar/Agents; if that sync fails, the create still succeeds and the error is returned, but the connection is left with indexing disabled.|

|namespaceDefinition|destination|

|scheduleType|basic|

|nonBreakingChangesPreference|disable|

<h2 id="tocS_ConnectionSyncStatus">ConnectionSyncStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaconnectionsyncstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_ConnectionSyncStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSconnectionsyncstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsconnectionsyncstatus"></a>

```json
"running"
```

The first of the following that matches for a given connection:
  * `RUNNING` - a job is currently running
  * `QUEUED` - a job is currently queued and waiting to start
  * `FAILED` - user action is required due to a breaking change or config error
  * `PAUSED` - connection is not active (inactive or deprecated)
  * `PENDING` - there is no previous sync job or the last completed job was a reset
  * `INCOMPLETE` - the last sync job's status is `failed`, user is not expected to be able to fix the issue
  * `SYNCED` - connection did not meet any of the above conditions, it has synced and is currently at rest

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|syncMode|[SyncMode](#schemasyncmode)|true|none|none|
|cursorField|[string]|false|none|Path to the field that will be used to determine if a record is new or modified since the last sync. This field is REQUIRED if `sync_mode` is `incremental`. Otherwise it is ignored.|
|destinationSyncMode|[DestinationSyncMode](#schemadestinationsyncmode)|true|none|none|
|namespace|string|false|none|Namespace of the stream.|
|primaryKey|[[string]]|false|none|Paths to the fields that will be used as primary key. This field is REQUIRED if `destination_sync_mode` is `*_dedup`. Otherwise it is ignored.|
|aliasName|string|false|none|Alias name to the stream to be used in the destination|
|selected|boolean|false|none|If this is true, the stream is selected with all of its properties. For new connections, this considers if the stream is suggested or not|
|suggested|boolean|false|none|Does the connector suggest that this stream be enabled by default?|
|destinationObjectName|string|false|none|The name of the destination object that this stream will be written to. This is used for data activation destinations.|
|includeFiles|boolean|false|none|Should the sync move raw files from the source to the destination?|
|fieldSelectionEnabled|boolean|false|none|Whether field selection should be enabled. If this is true, only the properties in `selectedFields` will be included.|
|selectedFields|[SelectedFields](#schemaselectedfields)|false|none|This must be set if `fieldSelectedEnabled` is set. An empty list indicates that no properties will be included.|
|hashedFields|[SelectedFields](#schemaselectedfields)|false|none|Fields that should be hashed before being written to the destination. Deprecated, use `mappers` instead.|
|mappers|[[ConfiguredStreamMapper](#schemaconfiguredstreammapper)]|false|none|Mappers that should be applied to the stream before writing to the destination.|
|minimumGenerationId|integer(int64)|false|none|The minimum generation Id of the stream|
|generationId|integer(int64)|false|none|Generation Id of the stream|
|syncId|integer(int64)|false|none|Sync id of the stream.|

<h2 id="tocS_OAuthConfigSpecification">OAuthConfigSpecification</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaoauthconfigspecification"></a>
<a id="schema_OAuthConfigSpecification"></a>
<a id="tocSoauthconfigspecification"></a>
<a id="tocsoauthconfigspecification"></a>

```json
{
  "oauthUserInputFromConnectorConfigSpecification": null,
  "completeOAuthOutputSpecification": null,
  "completeOAuthServerInputSpecification": null,
  "completeOAuthServerOutputSpecification": null
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|oauthUserInputFromConnectorConfigSpecification|[OAuthConfiguration](#schemaoauthconfiguration)|false|none|OAuth specific blob. This is a Json Schema used to validate Json configurations used as input to OAuth.<br>Must be a valid non-nested JSON that refers to properties from ConnectorSpecification.connectionSpecification<br>using special annotation 'path_in_connector_config'.<br>These are input values the user is entering through the UI to authenticate to the connector, that might also shared<br>as inputs for syncing data via the connector.<br><br>Examples:<br><br>if no connector values is shared during oauth flow, oauth_user_input_from_connector_config_specification=[]<br>if connector values such as 'app_id' inside the top level are used to generate the API url for the oauth flow,<br>  oauth_user_input_from_connector_config_specification={<br>    app_id: {<br>      type: string<br>      path_in_connector_config: ['app_id']<br>    }<br>  }<br>if connector values such as 'info.app_id' nested inside another object are used to generate the API url for the oauth flow,<br>  oauth_user_input_from_connector_config_specification={<br>    app_id: {<br>      type: string<br>      path_in_connector_config: ['info', 'app_id']<br>    }<br>  }|
|completeOAuthOutputSpecification|[OAuthConfiguration](#schemaoauthconfiguration)|false|none|OAuth specific blob. This is a Json Schema used to validate Json configurations produced by the OAuth flows as they are<br>returned by the distant OAuth APIs.<br>Must be a valid JSON describing the fields to merge back to `ConnectorSpecification.connectionSpecification`.<br>For each field, a special annotation `path_in_connector_config` can be specified to determine where to merge it,<br><br>Examples:<br><br>    complete_oauth_output_specification={<br>      refresh_token: {<br>        type: string,<br>        path_in_connector_config: ['credentials', 'refresh_token']<br>      }<br>    }|
|completeOAuthServerInputSpecification|[OAuthConfiguration](#schemaoauthconfiguration)|false|none|OAuth specific blob. This is a Json Schema used to validate Json configurations persisted as Airbyte Server configurations.<br>Must be a valid non-nested JSON describing additional fields configured by the Airbyte Instance or Workspace Admins to be used by the<br>server when completing an OAuth flow (typically exchanging an auth code for refresh token).<br><br>Examples:<br><br>    complete_oauth_server_input_specification={<br>      client_id: {<br>        type: string<br>      },<br>      client_secret: {<br>        type: string<br>      }<br>    }|
|completeOAuthServerOutputSpecification|[OAuthConfiguration](#schemaoauthconfiguration)|false|none|OAuth specific blob. This is a Json Schema used to validate Json configurations persisted as Airbyte Server configurations that<br>also need to be merged back into the connector configuration at runtime.<br>This is a subset configuration of `complete_oauth_server_input_specification` that filters fields out to retain only the ones that<br>are necessary for the connector to function with OAuth. (some fields could be used during oauth flows but not needed afterwards, therefore<br>they would be listed in the `complete_oauth_server_input_specification` but not `complete_oauth_server_output_specification`)<br>Must be a valid non-nested JSON describing additional fields configured by the Airbyte Instance or Workspace Admins to be used by the<br>connector when using OAuth flow APIs.<br>These fields are to be merged back to `ConnectorSpecification.connectionSpecification`.<br>For each field, a special annotation `path_in_connector_config` can be specified to determine where to merge it,<br><br>Examples:<br><br>      complete_oauth_server_output_specification={<br>        client_id: {<br>          type: string,<br>          path_in_connector_config: ['credentials', 'client_id']<br>        },<br>        client_secret: {<br>          type: string,<br>          path_in_connector_config: ['credentials', 'client_secret']<br>        }<br>      }|

```json
"PENDING"
```

Values:
  * `PENDING` - The stream operation has been selected to run
  * `RUNNING` - The stream operation is running
  * `COMPLETE` - The stream operation ran successfully to completion
  * `INCOMPLETE` - The stream operation has terminated in an incomplete state.
  See StreamStatusIncompleteRunCause for more details.
  * `RATE_LIMITED` - The stream is rate limited because the source has run out of API quota.
